facts.claim: Legal name EUROSICMA - COSTRUZIONI MACCHINE AUTOMATICHE S.P.A. (short form Eurosicma S.p.A.), Partita IVA 00730100153; the IMA group page uses the name 'Eurosicma - Costruzioni Macchine Automatiche S.p.A.'.
sources: AIDA export held in the tool
quote: Eurosicma – Costruzioni Macchine Automatiche S.p.A. | IMA Group

facts.claim: Plant and address today: Via Cassanese 102/104, 20052 Vignate (MI). The 2017 deal news still placed the company in Segrate (Milano): one company, two places over time, so a tool must not split them.
Incorporated 12 November 1962 as a company (AIDA); the group page and the 2017 news give 1965 as the year Eurosicma was founded: two dates a dossier must not blend.
sources: AIDA export held in the tool
quote: Founded in 1965 and located in Vignate (MI) in Italy

facts.claim: ATECO 28.29.30, manufacture of automatic machines for dosing, packaging and wrapping (AIDA).
sources: AIDA export held in the tool

facts.claim: Phone published for the factory on the IMA group page: +39 02 21 896 331 (Vignate).

The database website www.eurosicma.it is only a redirect (HTTP 301, checked 2026-10-27) to the parent group's page imagroup.com/brands/eurosicma/: the company has no separate site, every page a crawler reads is IMA group content, so entity matching must not mistake IMA's group-wide claims for Eurosicma's.
100% of the share capital is held directly by I.M.A. Industria Macchine Automatiche S.p.A. (IMA S.p.A., Bologna) (AIDA).
sources: AIDA export held in the tool

facts.claim: Control chain above IMA (AIDA): SO.FI.M.A. S.p.A. (level 2), Alps Holding S.p.A. (level 3), BDT Alps S.r.l. (level 4) and BDT Europe Fund SCSP (level 5): the ultimate controller is a fund-backed holding, not the founding family.
sources: AIDA export held in the tool

facts.claim: IMA agreed on 28 June 2017 to buy 60% of Eurosicma from the Redaelli family for about EUR 26M paid at closing, with put and call options on the remaining 40% exercisable by April 2027 (AIDA now shows 100% held by IMA).
quote: On 28 June Ima signed an agreement to acquire a 60% shareholding in Eurosicma
IMA will pay approximately €26 million at closing, scheduled for 30 September 2017, and will write Put & Call option contracts for the remaining 40% to be exercised by April 2027

facts.claim: Targeting consequence: Eurosicma is a controlled subsidiary of IMA, an Italian group that is itself controlled by an investment fund (BvD independence class D, no family share): decisions sit at IMA in Bologna. The tool must flag this; today it only lists shareholders.
sources: AIDA export held in the tool

facts.claim: 2017 trigger: at the time of the deal Eurosicma expected turnover of about EUR 27M and EBITDA of EUR 4.5M, with net cash of about EUR 7M (company figures quoted by the buyer).
facts.quote: is expected to post a turnover of around €27 million and EBITDA of €4.5 million in 2017

facts.claim: Strategic rationale stated in 2017: add Eurosicma's flowpack and fold wrapping range to IMA's product range (and use its capacity for the other IMA companies).
facts.quote: This strategic transaction will strengthen our Group’s leadership in the flowpack and fold automatic machinery sector

any: leadership in the flowpack and fold

facts.claim: Latest accounts (AIDA): revenue about EUR 16.1M and 94 employees. Compare 2017: expected turnover about EUR 27M.
sources: AIDA export held in the tool

facts.claim: Latest accounts show an operating LOSS: EBIT about EUR -3.18M, EBIT margin about -19.8% (AIDA). A decisive distress or restructuring signal for an approach.
sources: AIDA export held in the tool

quote: Leonardus Wilhelmus Johannes Van De Wiel

facts.claim: Delegated directors (consiglieri delegati): Luca Narducci and Alessandro Pierini; further directors Massimo Ferioli, Massimo Marchesini and Sergio Marzo.

facts.claim: Special attorneys (procuratori speciali) include Sergio Redaelli and Simona Redaelli: the founding family name is still in the signing roster after the sale.

facts.claim: In 2017 Marco Redaelli was managing director (amministratore delegato) of Eurosicma and the family was to stay in operational management.
facts.quote: Marco Redaelli, amministratore delegato di Eurosicma

facts.claim: Statutory auditors' board chaired by Piero Aicardi; external auditor EY S.p.A. (Ernst & Young) (AIDA).

quote: EY S.P.A., PER ESTESO ANCHE ERNST & YOUNG S.P.A.

facts.claim: Designs and makes horizontal form-fill-seal (HFFS / flowpack) machines and fully automated packaging lines for confectionery and bakery products: candies and gums, chocolate bars and tablets, biscuits, cakes, noodles.
facts.quote: IMA Eurosicma designs and manufactures HFFS machines and fully automated packaging lines for a wide range of confectionery and bakery products such as candies and gums, chocolate bars and tablets, biscuits, cakes, noodles

facts.claim: X-Fold wrappers for biscuits on edge and highly customised handling, feeding and portioning systems complete the range.
facts.quote: Highly customised handling, feeding and portioning systems and X-Fold wrappers for biscuits on edge complete the range

facts.claim: In 2017 the company was described as a Milan-based maker of automatic machinery and horizontal flowpack and fold packaging plants for the food, cosmetics and pharmaceuticals industries (the plaster-strip and personal-care niche).
facts.quote: the Milan-based manufacturer of automatic machinery and horizontal flowpack and fold packaging plants for the food, cosmetics and pharmaceuticals industries

facts.claim: Factory profile on the group page: about 100 employees, 10,000 sqm facility, installed base of more than 4,300 machines.
facts.quote: Staff 100 Employees Facility size 10 ,000 Sqm Installed base + 4 ,300 Machines

facts.claim: The 2017 deal is documented in a press release carried by the packaging-machinery association UCIMA (28 June 2017, with the buyer chairman's statement), a source for the deal timeline.
facts.quote: Alberto Vacchi, Chairman and CEO of IMA, commented

facts.claim: Group level, July 2023: BDT & MSD Partners agreed to buy a minority stake in IMA from BC Partners; the Vacchi family remains the majority owner of IMA (consistent with the AIDA chain above).
quote: The Vacchi family remains the majority owner of IMA
BDT & MSD Partners will acquire its position from BC Partners

facts.claim: AIDA: group of 120 companies, BvD independence class D, no subsidiary participations on record.
sources: AIDA export held in the tool

facts.claim: The Eurosicma page lists the technologies offered: feeding and manipulation (counting, alignment, portioning, robotics, tray loading), horizontal form-fill-seal flow wrappers, and wire-cut sandwiching machines for biscuits and crackers (group-level text shown on the brand page).
quote: IMA offers state-of-the-art wire cut sandwiching machines
counting, alignment, portioning, robotics, tray loading

facts.claim: Flow wrappers are configurable for food, coffee, home and personal care, tissue and non-wovens and pharmaceutical and medical products: end markets beyond confectionery.
facts.quote: packaging of food, coffee, home and personal care items, tissue and non-wovens, as well as pharmaceutical and medical products

any: packaging of food, coffee, home and personal care

facts.claim: The group site (shown around the Eurosicma page) has a 'Certified Management Systems' section and a 'Patents' section at group level; whether Eurosicma holds its own certificates was not established (a lead for the certification register ticket).
facts.quote: Mission, Vision and History Certified Management Systems Patents IMA Digital Sustainability OPENLab

facts.claim: The group site offers financial documents including bondholder information and the documents of a public tender offer ('OPA - IMA Financial Documents'): the group's ownership events are documented there.
facts.quote: Financial Bondholders OPA – IMA Financial Documents
